description: Named menu added to the macOS menu bar; used inside a WindowGroup commands array

children.description: Array of Button or Divider child elements

name.description: Non-empty menu title displayed in the menu bar

autoPopulate.description: Host extension: when true, the host fills this menu's items dynamically at launch instead of from 'children'. Hosts that don't support it ignore it.

role.description: ActionUIWeb-only: 'account' renders this menu as the shell's account button (top-right avatar) instead of a menu-bar entry. Only the first account menu is used; later ones warn and are ignored. Suffix as 'role:web'.

systemImage.description: ActionUIWeb-only: SF Symbol name for the account button's glyph, resolved through the SF-to-Material map. Read only when role:web is 'account'; defaults to a person glyph. Suffix as 'systemImage:web'.
